title: Eco-friendly carbon dot-based nanocomposites in smart construction materials for green-house gases reduction
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18342-18358
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01080F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Basel Abd Elshafy, Mahmoud Hazem, Heba El-Shafey, Omar Mbrouk, Hoda Hafez
Smart cement composites with CD-semiconductor nanocomposites (TiO2, ZnO, SiO2) enhance CO2 capture and mechanical strength. Quantum-engineered CDs offer synergistic effects, with recyclable photocatalytic activity under solar light.
